html.body: Date: 2025-04-30 U.S. Application No. 17/225,382 A0005708US01 (10259-141) ARGUMENTS/REMARKSApplicant submits this Amendment After Allowance pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 after receipt of the Notice of Allowance and Fees Due dated February 6, 2025. Claim 9 is currently amended without adding any new matter. Claims 5 and 18-20 were previously canceled. No claims are currently added or canceled herein. Accordingly, claims 1-4, 6-17, and 21-23 remain present and ready for issuance.Claim 9 has been amended to correct minor informalities, and no new matter has been introduced. No substantial amount of additional work on the part of the Office is required. In particular, the scope of the claims is not affected by the proposed amendment. Therefore, no additional search or examination is required, and the claims remain patentable. This amendment was not presented earlier because it was discovered only after Applicant reviewed the allowed claims.Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 1.312, an amendment may be entered after the mailing of a Notice of Allowance, but prior to the payment of the Issue Fee, upon the recommendation of the primary Examiner. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the above-referenced application be amended as set forth herein. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned by telephone if doing so would expedite resolution of this matter.Respectfully submitted, SHERIDAN ROSS P.C.Date: April 30, 2025 By: /Eric A. Bomkamp/ Eric A. Bomkamp Registration No. 71,218 1560 Broadway, Suite 1200 Denver, CO 80202 Telephone: 303-863-9700 Facsimile: 303-863-0223 8
